sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: The Orrios Exchange (Lonja) building reflects the traditional "Exchange–Town Hall" typology characteristic of Teruel's vernacular architecture. The structure features a Renaissance loggia with masonry semicircular arches on the ground floor, topped by two upper levels added during subsequent periods.
